messages:
maria: heads-up — planning a soft-start rollout for model `rwd-v2p1-quant4` tomorrow. trying a vote-based promotion instead of a strict % ramp. details below, want quick alignment.
ajay: vote-based? can you sketch the gating logic? how do we avoid oscillation/safety problems?
maria: yep. idea is small initial shadow -> 1% live traffic as a 'voter' slice for 24h. each request gets a lightweight fidelity score and a human-like agreement signal from our eval hooks. we compute a rolling voting score per slice. promote when score >= 0.92 on primary slices and latency tail < 95th baseline * 1.2.
sam: what signals are in the voting score? is it just concordance w/ baseline or include hallucination detectors?
maria: composite: 60% concordance vs control, 20% hallucination penalty (automated heuristics + RTE checks), 20% safety flag rate (safety infra). also require that token cost delta is within expected band.
ian: add: require no burst of upstream errors and no increase in top-k perplexity > 5% on docs slice. also suggest a cooldown hysteresis: if score dips below 0.88 for 2 consecutive 1h buckets, auto-fallback.
ajay: agree on hysteresis. how do we compute and surface the slice-level votes? need dashboard + alert.
maria: will push a minimal dashboard with these panels: voting_score (by slice), discordant_examples (sampled), latency_tail, error_rate, halluc_flag_rate. alert rules: voting_score_drop (<0.88) OR latency_95th > baseline*1.35 for 10m -> trigger sqs fallback and rollback job.
sam: can we keep an opt-out quick rollback command? like `rw rollout cancel --id <id>` + force fallback so support can run it.
maria: yes, will add that CLI. planned rollout command (WIP):
```
rw rollout create --model rwd-v2p1-quant4 --policy soft-start-vote --slices default,docs,search --voter-pct 1 --watch 24h --promote-threshold 0.92 --fallback-threshold 0.88
```
ajay: nice. what about A/B stats significance? do we wait for p<0.05 or just the voting window?
maria: voting score integrates bootstrap significance internally for concordance part; explicit p-value gating for core metrics (latency/error) still required. we won't promote unless A/B concordance p<0.1 AND voting_score >= threshold.
ian: test vectors? we need a small corpus for docs/search slices focusing on hallucination-prone prompts. can we reuse the existing 'halluc-sanity-50' plus a new long-context set?
maria: yes, will add long-context 30-case set to the eval harness. plan: run a preflight shadow run tonight, post results in this thread.
dev-bot: deploy-bot created shadow run job id: shadow-1765432101-a. started at 2025-11-05T03:12:00Z.
sam: quick note: set the KV-cache warmup policy on the pod template so cold starts don't bias early latency.
maria: good call — will pin cache_warmup: on for the 1% voter pool.
ajay: ack. if anyone objects to this plan please reply by EOD, otherwise we kick tomorrow 0100 UTC. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — will post preflight summary after shadow finishes.
